title: Assistify shared field-progress contract
description: Vendor-neutral data contract for replacing the prototype localStorage progress store. Plan/model truth remains a separate versioned resource.

fields.id: stable UUID or existing Assistify project id
fields.modelRevision: immutable model revision or content hash; optional

stageProgress.description: Current materialized snapshot; unique by projectId plus stageId.

fields.version: positive integer used for optimistic concurrency

progressEvent.description: Append-only audit event. Never update or delete in normal application flows.

fields.idempotencyKey: client-generated UUID; unique per project for safe offline retries
fields.actorUserId: authenticated actor foreign key; never trust a client display name
fields.actorDisplayNameSnapshot: optional display label captured for history

fields.objectKey: private object-storage key, not a public URL
fields.caption: optional plain text

requiredOperations: list projects visible to the authenticated user
get one project's twelve current stage snapshots
list progress events with cursor pagination
atomically append an event and update its stage snapshot
request a short-lived evidence upload target
finalize an uploaded evidence asset after server-side validation
subscribe to or poll changes after a server cursor
writeRules: The server derives actorUserId from the authenticated session.
Every read and write is authorized through project membership.
An idempotencyKey retry returns the original successful event.
A stale baseVersion returns a conflict and the current snapshot; do not silently overwrite it.
status complete requires percent 100; status not-started requires percent 0.
Timestamps used for ordering are generated by the server.
Event history is append-only; corrections are new events.
Progress data never changes geometry provenance or plan verification state.

clientSync.offlineCache: IndexedDB or localStorage may cache snapshots and an outbox, but is not authoritative
clientSync.outbox: queue idempotent events and evidence uploads while offline
clientSync.conflictPolicy: show the server snapshot and ask the user to reconcile a stale edit
clientSync.cursor: persist the last server cursor per project and fetch changes after it
clientSync.migration: read assistify3d:progress:<projectId> once, offer an explicit reviewed import, and mark it migrated only after server acknowledgement

securityMinimums: private evidence storage with short-lived signed access
server-side file type, size, and malware validation
rate limits and an immutable actor/time audit trail
no credentials, tokens, customer plan PDFs, or personal data committed to Git
